0022600180.text: The Cavaliers (4-3, 2nd in the Central, 4th in the East) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 4th in the West) for Cleveland's eighth game of the season, after losing their most recent game and going 1-2 on the road. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), while Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 117-112 in Cleveland on November 2, and they also lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season.
